Exclude selectors work in plain text output mode

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import ConversionOptions, OutputFormat, convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<body><div class="nav">Navigation</div><p>Article body</p></body>'
    options = ConversionOptions(exclude_selectors=[".nav"], output_format=OutputFormat("Plain"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
